source_cn:
<M_Default>致新同事：</>

       我注意到你已经收集到了不少的异象之物，我最近正好在俱乐部这边停留，记得有空来找我，我为你准备了丰厚的兑换奖励。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=2000009">【前往俱乐部】</>

       顺便多说一句——如果你还没加入俱乐部，那我非常建议你来试试。官方非凡者的身份虽然好用，但有些门路和消息，只有在这种地方才能获取。我在值夜者之外，也总需要一些自己的“消息来源”和“熟人圈子”，这些在非凡之路的晋升上帮过我不止一次。

       总之，先来俱乐部找我。兑换的事，当面交接比较稳妥。
ref_en:
<M_Default> To my new colleague: </>

 I noticed you have collected quite a few Objects of Phenomenon. I happen to be staying at the Club recently; remember to come find me when you have time. I have prepared generous exchange rewards for you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=2000009"> [Go to Club] </> 
 
 By the way—if you haven't joined a Club yet, I highly recommend you try it. While being an official Beyonder is useful, some channels and information can only be obtained in such places. Outside of the Nighthawks, I always need my own "sources of information" and "circle of acquaintances." These have helped me more than once in my advancement on the path of the Beyonder. 

 Anyway, come find me at the Club first. It's safer to handle the exchanges in person.

ref_en: Club Instructions</> Join or create a Club to participate in various Club activities, obtain rich event rewards and Peer Emblems. Peer Emblems can be exchanged for reward items in the Club shop. Clubs are divided into Leisure Clubs and Combat Clubs, which can be adjusted in the Club information modification section. Leisure Clubs will not display Beyonder ratings in the member list. Club member locking rules: During Club-based gameplay activities (such as Four-Way League, Phantom of the Opera, Hunting City War, Plateau War), Clubs do not allow members to join or leave. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Creating a Responsive Club</> When your character reaches level 20, you can choose to join a Club or create one yourself. Creating a Club requires paying a creation fee. If the number of responses reaches 4 within 24 hours after creation, the creation is successful; otherwise, it will fail. Neither failed creation nor active cancellation of creation will refund the creation fee.

岁月如棋，落子无悔，一步踏错，便是百年。

一副古老的棋盘静置于案，被放缓的时间里，隐约能看到一只大手和一只小手下棋的旧影。罗塞尔曾与贝尔纳黛对弈，谈起“烂柯棋局”的传说——那山中樵夫观棋片刻，人间已过百年。

那时贝尔纳黛听不懂什么是烂柯，不懂为什么父亲总会把棋子下在交叉点上，也不懂什么是“观棋不语真君子，落子无悔大丈夫”，她只记得耍赖悔棋时父亲会轻拍她的头顶，手掌宽厚而温暖。
ref_en:
Time is like a game of chess; once a piece is placed, there is no regret. One wrong step, and a hundred years have passed.

An ancient chessboard sat quietly on the desk. In the slowed time, one could faintly see the old shadows of a large hand and a small hand playing chess. Roselle once played against Bernadette and spoke of the legend of the "Lanke Chess Game"—the woodcutter in the mountains watched the game for a moment, and a hundred years had passed in the human world.

At that time, Bernadette didn't understand what Lanke was, why her father always placed his pieces on the intersections, or what "a true gentleman watches the game in silence, and a real man never regrets his move" meant. She only remembered that when she tried to cheat or take back a move, her father would gently pat her head, his palm broad and warm.

他是最棒的小丑，无需涂抹厚重的油彩，便能奉上最浮夸的笑容。这笑容如同一张完美的面具，与他的脸严丝合缝，请将嘴角咧到最大，笑容最为无可挑剔，哪怕眼神空洞无比。
他的表演无人能及，他的荒诞如此可笑。他的一举一动皆能触及到观众最精准的神经，每次出糗都能引发人群歇斯底里的大笑。孩子们爱他，大人们在他身上找到生活压力的发泄，他用自己的笑容为整个世界带来欢乐！
然而幕布落下，笑声散去，独处时面对镜中永远笑着的自己，他只能以沉默，以夸张的笑容回应。
最后的舞台来临，他将故事中君主赐死弄臣的酒换成真实的毒酒，一饮而尽。当他带着笑容倒下时，全场响起排山倒海的欢呼与笑声。

演出，落幕了……再次祝你们……永远开心。
ref_en:
He was the best Clown, needing no thick oil paint to offer the most exaggerated smile. This smile was like a perfect mask, fitting his face seamlessly. Please stretch the corners of your mouth to the maximum; the smile was impeccable, even if his eyes were completely hollow. 
 His performance was unmatched, his absurdity so laughable. Every move he made could touch the most precise nerves of the audience, and every blunder could trigger hysterical laughter from the crowd. Children loved him, adults found an outlet for the pressures of life in him, and he brought joy to the whole world with his own smile! 
 However, when the curtain fell and the laughter dispersed, facing himself in the mirror who was always smiling while alone, he could only respond with silence and an exaggerated smile. 
 The final stage arrived; he replaced the poisoned wine the monarch gave the jester in the story with real poisoned wine and drank it in one gulp. When he fell with a smile, thunderous cheers and laughter erupted throughout the arena. 
 
 The show... has come to a curtain call... Wishing you all again... to be happy forever.

source_cn:
如果客人想在本店购买商品，请务必严格遵守以下规则，如有违者，后果自负。
1.本店营业时间为每天3点至5点。
2.店员工作时间为每天10点。
3.请不要相信店员的话。
4.购买三次商品后，请立即离开商店。
ref_en:
If guests wish to purchase items at this store, please strictly adhere to the following rules. Violators will be responsible for the consequences. 
1. Our business hours are from 3 to 5 every day. 
2. The clerk's working hours are at 10 every day. 
3. Please do not believe the clerk's words. 
4. After purchasing items three times, please leave the store immediately.

source_cn: 参与跑团前，非凡者必须选择一个教团加入，方可开启跑团之行。\n非凡者可根据个人兴趣自由选择心仪的教团加入。在任意教团等级达到4级前，非凡者可随意更换教团，在教团等级达到4级后，每次切换教团将进入7天的冷却时间。\n选定教团还可以自由调整探秘属性，每维属性最低为8点，最高为16点，共计可将12点属性点分配给4个维度的属性当中，建议按照推荐属性点进行加点，可使后续的探秘更加轻松。
ref_en: Before participating in a TRPG session, Beyonders must choose a sect to join to begin their journey. \nBeyonders can freely choose their preferred sect based on personal interest. Before any sect reaches level 4, Beyonders can change sects at will. After a sect reaches level 4, each change of sect will trigger a 7-day cooldown.\nAfter selecting a sect, you can also freely adjust your Exploration attributes. Each dimension of attributes has a minimum of 8 points and a maximum of 16 points. A total of 12 attribute points can be allocated among the 4 dimensions. It is recommended to allocate points according to the recommended attributes to make subsequent exploration easier.

由一根根豌豆藤蔓构筑起的青绿森林，摇晃的秋千不知勾起了谁的童年回忆。

在众多童话故事中，“杰克与豌豆”被罗塞尔赋予了蒸汽与机械的奇想。他将平凡的豌豆藤描绘成由齿轮驱动的奇迹，让杰克用智慧改造巨人的城堡，将吃人的怪物变为烤蛋糕的伙伴。那也是贝尔纳黛好奇心最重的时候，“爸爸，巨人是弗萨克人吗？”“城堡怎么建在云上的呢，云不是水吗？”“要多高才能看到城堡呀，坐飞空艇能够看到吗？我想上去看看！”……

多么古怪的问题都会获得回应，多么天真的想法都会得到满足。
ref_en:
A green forest constructed from pea vines; the swaying swing evokes childhood memories for someone.

 Among many fairy tales, "Jack and the Beanstalk" was imbued with Roselle's whimsy for steam and machinery. He depicted the ordinary beanstalk as a miracle driven by gears, letting Jack use his wisdom to remodel the giant's castle and turn the man-eating monster into a partner for baking cakes. That was also when Bernadette was most curious: "Papa, is the giant a Feynapotter?" "How is the castle built on the clouds? Aren't clouds water?" "How high do you have to be to see the castle? Can you see it from an airship? I want to go up and see!"...

 Every strange question would receive a response, and every naive thought would be satisfied.

<Assistant_Title1>Beyonder Material Synthesis</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Instructions:</>
Beyonder Material Synthesis is unlocked when your Acting level reaches 47. You can synthesize two Beyonder materials into a new one.
1. During synthesis, the entries of the resulting product are <Assistant_Red>entirely</> randomly selected from the entries of the <Assistant_Red>input Beyonder materials</>.
2. There is a very small probability of mutation during synthesis, generating <Assistant_Property2>Mutated Entries</>. The possible Mutated Entries vary depending on the total number and types of entries in the input Beyonder materials.
3. When you possess at least 2 Attack Beyonder materials and 2 Defense Beyonder materials with 4 or more entries, you unlock the ability to use 4-entry Beyonder materials for synthesis; when you possess at least 2 Attack Beyonder materials and 2 Defense Beyonder materials with 5 entries, you unlock the ability to use 5-entry Beyonder materials for synthesis.
4. Performing Beyonder material synthesis increases <Assistant_Property1>Synthesis Proficiency</>. Synthesis Proficiency resets each season, and you can obtain rewards after reaching certain values.

<Assistant_Title1>【Plateau Battle】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Description:</><Assistant_System>Plateau Battle</> is an <Assistant_Red>800-player</> battlefield in the Faction War. Battlefield qualifications are distributed at <Assistant_Red>21:20</> after the first match of each round of the Four-Way League. Members of qualified Clubs can view the schedule in the <Assistant_System>War-to-War - Faction - Plateau Battle</> interface.
<Assistant_Title2>Core Objective:</>Each faction needs to compete for the <Assistant_Property1>Death Knight</> on the central platform of the battlefield. The Death Knight will follow the faction with the most Beyonders within <Assistant_Red>20 meters</>, and following requires at least <Assistant_Red>5 people</>. The faction near the Death Knight will periodically gain faction points, and the faction followed by the Death Knight gains more points.
<Assistant_Title2>Victory Rules:</>Successfully delivering the Death Knight to your own camp square grants an additional <Assistant_Red>1200 Faction Points</>. The faction that reaches <Assistant_Red>15000 Faction Points</> wins early; when the battle ends, rewards of different tiers will be distributed based on the ranking of the Four Emperors' Faction Points.
<Assistant_Title2>Disadvantage Mechanism:</>Factions with a difference of <Assistant_Red>3000 Faction Points</> from the first place are considered disadvantaged factions. Every <Assistant_Red>5 minutes</>, <Assistant_Property1>Tripwires</> will be dropped in front of the disadvantaged faction's square, which can only be picked up by Beyonders of that faction and used to slow down the Death Knight; every <Assistant_Red>8 minutes</>, a group teleport will open at the disadvantaged faction's square, requiring <Assistant_Red>1</> Beyonder to go to the square area to activate it. Upon success, all Beyonders of that faction can teleport to the square area and gain a powerful buff.
<Assistant_Title2>Participation Method:</>{JumpToUI:[前往高原战]|1250323}

为确保游客的人身安全，采摘期间，请务必遵守以下规则。
1.苹果是一种圆形的红色水果，表皮光滑，口感甜脆。请不要采摘苹果之外的东西。
2.如果你看见苹果上长出稻谷，请立即远离，并寻找看守人员。
<Delete id="#158">3.长出小麦是正常的，请放心品尝。</>
4.请注意，苹果不会长出任何人体组织。
5.如果你服用了长出稻谷或器官的苹果，不要尝试呕吐，请立即寻找看守人员。
6.本告示共有五条。
0.欢迎大家前来湖心岛果园品尝苹果！
ref_en:
To ensure the personal safety of tourists, please be sure to follow the following rules during picking. 
 1. An apple is a round red fruit with smooth skin and a sweet and crisp taste. Please do not pick anything other than apples. 
 2. If you see rice growing on an apple, please stay away immediately and look for the guards. 
<Delete id="#158"> 3. It is normal for wheat to grow, please feel free to taste it. </>
 4. Please note that apples will not grow any human tissue. 
 5. If you have consumed an apple that has grown rice or organs, do not try to vomit, please look for the guards immediately. 
 6. There are five rules in this notice. 
 0. Welcome everyone to the orchard on the island in the middle of the lake to taste apples!

<Assistant_Title1>【高原战】</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</><Assistant_System>高原战</>是势力战中的<Assistant_Red>800人</>战场。战场资格会在每轮四方联赛第一场结束后<Assistant_Red>21:20</>分配，获得资格的俱乐部成员可在<Assistant_System>以战养战-势力-高原战</>界面查看赛程安排。
<Assistant_Title2>核心目标：</>各势力需要争夺战场中央平台上的<Assistant_Property1>死亡骑士</>。死亡骑士会跟随身边<Assistant_Red>20米</>内非凡者数量最多的势力，且获得跟随至少需要<Assistant_Red>5人</>。死亡骑士身边的势力会定时增加势力积分，获得死亡骑士跟随的势力加分更高。
<Assistant_Title2>胜利规则：</>成功将死亡骑士送达本阵营广场，可额外获得<Assistant_Red>1200势力积分</>。达到<Assistant_Red>15000势力积分</>的势力会提前获胜；战斗结束时，会根据四皇势力积分排名发放不同档次奖励。
<Assistant_Title2>劣势机制：</>与第一名相差<Assistant_Red>3000势力积分</>的势力会被视为劣势势力。每<Assistant_Red>5分钟</>，劣势势力广场前会投放<Assistant_Property1>绊马索</>，只有本势力非凡者可以拾取，使用后可减速死亡骑士；每<Assistant_Red>8分钟</>，劣势势力广场会开启集合传送，需要<Assistant_Red>1名</>非凡者前往广场区域激活，成功后该势力所有非凡者可传送至广场区域并获得强力buff。
<Assistant_Title2>参与方式：</>{JumpToUI:[前往高原战]|1250323}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Highland Battle】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Description: </><Assistant_System>Highland Battle</> is an <Assistant_Red>800-player</> battlefield in the Faction War. Eligibility is assigned at <Assistant_Red>21:20</> after the first match of each Four-Way League round. Eligible club members can view the schedule in the <Assistant_System>War-Driven Growth - Faction - Highland Battle</> interface.
<Assistant_Title2>Core Objective: </>Factions must compete for the <Assistant_Property1>Dead Knight</> on the central platform of the battlefield. The Dead Knight will follow the faction with the most Beyonders within <Assistant_Red>20 meters</>, and requires at least <Assistant_Red>5 people</> to follow. The faction near the Dead Knight gains faction points periodically, with the faction being followed gaining more points.
<Assistant_Title2>Victory Rules: </>Successfully escorting the Dead Knight to your faction's plaza grants an additional <Assistant_Red>1200 faction points</>. The faction that reaches <Assistant_Red>15000 faction points</> wins early; at the end of the battle, rewards are distributed based on the faction point ranking.
<Assistant_Title2>Disadvantage Mechanism: </>Factions trailing the first place by <Assistant_Red>3000 faction points</> are considered disadvantaged. Every <Assistant_Red>5 minutes</>, <Assistant_Property1>Tripwires</> will be dropped in front of the disadvantaged faction's plaza, which can only be picked up by their own Beyonders and used to slow down the Dead Knight; every <Assistant_Red>8 minutes</>, a group teleport will open at the disadvantaged faction's plaza, requiring <Assistant_Red>1</> Beyonder to go to the plaza area to activate it. Once successful, all Beyonders of that faction can teleport to the plaza area and gain a powerful buff.
<Assistant_Title2>How to Participate: </>{JumpToUI:[Go to Highland Battle]|1250323}

The armor has a name: Ethan. 
 When its master died, it moved once and performed a knight's salute to everyone present. It guarded this family for a very, very long time. Countless sword strikes left marks on it, but it never took a single step back. 
 Someone chanted a spell to awaken it, and it drew its sword. But the sword was not pointed at the enemy. 
 It does not know why it did this; the influence of ■■■■ has seeped into the Beyonder characteristic it inherited, which is hard for anyone to notice. 
 But one thing never changed until the end—it never stopped fighting.

1.每位非凡者同时至多可以领取3个悬赏。
2.悬赏令将在非凡者完成悬赏的时候刷新。
3.悬赏被完成后，6分钟内不会再次刷新同一个悬赏。
4.非凡者们可以选择主动点击刷新，刷新所有悬赏。但刷新次数，每日只有3次。
5.非凡者完成悬赏后将会获得治安经验，和绑定苏勒。治安经验可以提升治安官等级
6.非凡者可以在治安技能树页面可以对治安技能进行升级和养成，强化自身的六维属性。
7.悬赏令分为A、B、C三个等级，分别在治安1、2、4级的时候开启。
8.接取悬赏令后，非凡者的任务列表中会同步接取悬赏任务，点击对应的任务可以自动寻路至悬赏位置。
ref_en:
Beyonders can learn the knowledge and techniques of a Sheriff, become a qualified "Sheriff," and act out the "Sheriff" identity to gradually acquire various Beyonder abilities from the "Blessing Slate" through "Pre-Acting." 
 1. Each Beyonder can accept up to 3 bounties at a time. 
 2. The bounty list refreshes when a Beyonder completes a bounty. 
 3. Once a bounty is completed, the same bounty will not refresh again for 6 minutes. 
 4. Beyonders can choose to manually click refresh to refresh all bounties, but this is limited to 3 times per day. 
 5. Upon completing a bounty, Beyonders gain Sheriff EXP and bound Gold Pounds. Sheriff EXP can increase your Sheriff level. 
 6. Beyonders can upgrade and cultivate Sheriff skills on the Sheriff Skill Tree page to strengthen their six-dimensional attributes. 
 7. Bounties are divided into A, B, and C grades, unlocked at Sheriff levels 1, 2, and 4 respectively. 
 8. After accepting a bounty, the bounty quest will be synced to your quest list; clicking the corresponding quest will trigger auto-pathfinding to the bounty location.

<Assistant_Title1>【俱乐部乱斗-得分规则】</>
玩家将根据投影在战场上的表现而累计得分：
按照存活的排名，前三名投影依次获得<Assistant_Red>60,40,30</>分，
每有其他投影阵亡，自身投影获得<Assistant_Red>3</>分，
击杀其他投影获得<Assistant_Red>5</>分。
玩家需投入<Assistant_Red>8</>名以上的投影以获得奖励。比赛结束后，总分优秀者与对应投影数据突出者将额外获得<Assistant_Property1>称号</>奖励。

ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Club Brawl - Scoring Rules】</>
Players will accumulate scores based on the performance of their projections on the battlefield:
According to the survival ranking, the top three projections receive <Assistant_Red>60, 40, 30</> points respectively. 
For every other projection that falls, your own projection gains <Assistant_Red>3</> points, 
and killing other projections grants <Assistant_Red>5</> points.
Players must deploy at least <Assistant_Red>8</> projections to be eligible for rewards. After the match, those with excellent total scores and outstanding projection data will receive additional <Assistant_Property1>Title</> rewards.

source_cn:
灰色的麋鹿突然仰首长鸣，它角上的羽毛纷纷发出柔光，飘到空中接续起了戴莉未完成的歌。它的鹿角记住了每片羽毛中储存的音符，它笨拙的收集无意中保存了戴莉所有的歌声。

　　直到鹿角触碰到最后一个音符的时刻，光亮也在出现在眼前，猫头鹰长老在洞口拼命甩着翅膀欢迎英雄的归来。

　　戴莉再次醒来是在温暖而干燥的落叶堆里，它惊讶地发现身上覆盖着全新的羽毛——银白色的，如雾般轻盈蓬松。邓恩安静地守在落叶堆旁，角上依然挂着木牌，最新一块刻着：“戴莉拥有了一身新的羽毛，记得赞美它。”

　　后来，森林里流传着这样的故事：这里有两位守护者，深沉的鹿蹄声和清亮的鸟叫声完美交融，它们在歌声和鹿角中记录每一朵花的绽放，每条溪流的改道和每个生命的成长。邓恩的遗忘还在循环，但它每天都赞美戴莉的羽毛；戴莉的羽毛不再随歌声掉落，每段旋律都让羽毛更有光泽。

　　有些记忆会在冬雪中被埋藏，有些记忆会在回响中永恒。即使遗忘，善良也会为弱者驻足，即使失去，爱会赋予重构的勇气。
ref_en:
The gray elk suddenly raised its head and let out a long cry. The feathers on its antlers emitted a soft light, floating into the air to continue Daly's unfinished song. Its antlers remembered the notes stored in every feather, and its clumsy collection unintentionally saved all of Daly's singing. 

 Until the moment the antlers touched the last note, light also appeared before its eyes. The Owl Elder was flapping its wings desperately at the cave entrance to welcome the hero's return. 

 Daly woke up again in a warm and dry pile of fallen leaves. It was surprised to find that its body was covered with brand-new feathers—silver-white, as light and fluffy as mist. Dunn was quietly guarding by the leaf pile, with a wooden sign still hanging on his antlers, the latest one carved with: "Daly has a new set of feathers, remember to praise it." 

 Later, such a story circulated in the forest: there were two Guardians here, the deep sound of deer hooves and the clear chirping of birds blended perfectly. They recorded every blooming flower, every change in the course of the stream, and the growth of every life in their songs and antlers. Dunn's loss of control was still cycling, but he praised Daly's feathers every day; Daly's feathers no longer fell with the singing, and every melody made the feathers more lustrous. 

 Some memories will be buried in the winter snow, and some memories will be eternal in the echoes. Even if forgotten, kindness will stop for the weak; even if lost, love will give the courage to reconstruct.

source_cn: ……任何两个整数，若它们除以某个正整数的余数相等，则称它们关于该模数同余。同余理论是数论的基石，然而在更广阔的代数数域中，唯一分解律并不总是成立。\n　　我们不得不引入理想数的概念来弥补这一缺陷。\n　　这一缺陷最初只是作为反例被注意到——在某些二次域中，同一个整数可以被分解为不同的素因子乘积，分解的唯一性荡然无存。这对整个算术大厦构成了根本性的动摇。
ref_en: ...Any two integers, if their remainders when divided by a certain positive integer are equal, are said to be congruent with respect to that modulus. Congruence theory is the cornerstone of number theory, yet in the broader algebraic number field, the law of unique factorization does not always hold. \n We have to introduce the concept of ideal numbers to make up for this defect. \n This defect was initially noticed only as a counterexample—in some quadratic fields, the same integer can be decomposed into products of different prime factors, and the uniqueness of decomposition vanishes. This constitutes a fundamental shaking of the entire arithmetic edifice.

source_cn:
在霍纳奇斯山脉下有一处终年被银色雾气包裹的森林，里面住着各自各样的珍稀动物。其中，有一头叫做邓恩的麋鹿住在森林的最深处，它有着云朵般柔软的灰色皮毛和比橡木还要坚实的巨大鹿角，走路时的蹄声沉稳地如同森林的呼吸。它是这座森林的守护者，拥有洞察森林每一个角落的力量，但这份力量也伴随着诅咒——每年第一场雪落下的时候，它就会开始遗忘。

　　先是刚刚的对话，然后是昨天帮助过的动物，最后连自己的名字都如同飘落的雪花，落在地上了无痕迹。他只好把重要的事情都刻下来，做成木牌挂在鹿角上提醒自己。

　　有一只叫戴莉的知更鸟住在森林的东边，雾气更加浓郁的地方。它有着绯红色的羽毛，它可以用歌声编织出金色的旋律，为迷路的生灵指引方向。但这里藏着它的秘密：每编织一段完整的旋律，它就会掉落一根羽毛，掉落的羽毛不会再生长。
ref_en:
At the foot of the Hornacis Mountain Range, there is a forest covered in silver mist all year round, where various rare animals live. Among them, a reindeer named Dunn lives in the deepest part of the forest. It has gray fur as soft as clouds and huge antlers stronger than oak, and its hoofbeats when walking are as steady as the forest's breathing. It is the guardian of this forest and possesses the power to gain insight into every corner of the forest, but this power comes with a curse—every year when the first snow falls, it begins to forget. 

　　First, it's the conversation just now, then the animals it helped yesterday, and finally even its own name falls to the ground like falling snowflakes, leaving no trace. It has to carve important things onto wooden boards and hang them on its antlers to remind itself. 

　　There is a robin named Daly living in the east of the forest, where the mist is thicker. It has crimson feathers, and it can weave golden melodies with its singing to guide lost creatures. But here lies its secret: every time it weaves a complete melody, it loses a feather, and the lost feathers will not grow back.

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【理智值】</>
<Assistant_Title2>名词介绍：</>在非凡世界中行动时，各类事件将使玩家的理智值发生波动。当理智值持续降低，异常状态将从肉体开始，逐步向以太体、心智体、星灵体、精神体蔓延侵蚀，角色将依次进入不同程度的精神状态，并产生对应的效果。 
<Assistant_Title2>理智值档位：</> 理智值分为以下档位，不同档位有不同效果：
理智值充足时，角色处于<Assistant_System>「心智锚定」（100-80）</>状态，体力消耗下降且减伤提升；降至正常水平则进入<Assistant_System>「清醒」（60-79）</>状态，该状态没有任何效果。

随着理智值进一步下降，角色依次进入<Assistant_System>「心神不宁」（45-59）「自我存疑」（30-44）「低语缠身」（20-29）</>状态，行动速度与冲刺稳定性受到不同程度的削弱，周遭将出现呓语干扰。

当理智值降至较低区间，角色进入<Assistant_System>「陷入疯狂」（10-19）</>状态，行动限制完全解除，伤害与受到伤害均有所提升。

理智值跌至更低时，角色进入<Assistant_System>「失控边缘」（1-9）</>状态，<Assistant_System>伤害提升</>，但受到伤害同步增加，且受到的治疗效果降低，自身发出红光，视野变得疯狂。

当理智值为0，并持续一定时间时，会有<Assistant_Red>恐怖</>的事情发生！
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Sanity】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Term Introduction: </>When acting in the Extraordinary World, various events will cause fluctuations in the player's Sanity. As Sanity continues to decrease, abnormal states will begin from the physical body and gradually spread to erode the Etheric Body, Astral Body, Mental Body, and Spirit Body. The character will enter different levels of mental states in sequence, producing corresponding effects. 
<Assistant_Title2>Sanity Tiers: </> Sanity is divided into the following tiers, each with different effects: 
When Sanity is sufficient, the character is in the <Assistant_System>"Mental Anchor" (100-80) </> state, where stamina consumption is reduced and damage reduction is increased; when it drops to a normal level, the character enters the <Assistant_System>"Sober" (60-79) </> state, which has no effects. 

As Sanity decreases further, the character enters the <Assistant_System>"Restlessness" (45-59), "Self-Doubt" (30-44), and "Whispers Haunting" (20-29) </> states in sequence. Movement speed and sprint stability are weakened to varying degrees, and whispers will appear to interfere with the surroundings. 

When Sanity drops to a lower range, the character enters the <Assistant_System>"Falling into Madness" (10-19) </> state, where movement restrictions are completely lifted, and both damage dealt and damage taken are increased. 

When Sanity drops even lower, the character enters the <Assistant_System>"Edge of Loss of Control" (1-9) </> state, where <Assistant_System>Damage Increase </> is active, but damage taken is simultaneously increased, healing effects received are reduced, the character emits a red glow, and their vision becomes frenzied. 

When Sanity reaches 0 and remains there for a certain period, <Assistant_Red>terrifying </> things will happen!

source_cn:
好久不见。
　　自廷根湖异变后，值夜者封锁了廷根湖边区域处理遗留的污染，目前已经处理完毕，重新解除了封锁。
　　不过最近巡逻的同事告诉我，湖边近日忽然多了几张桌椅和帐篷，应该解除封锁后，有人来到这边进行了活动。
　　保险起见，值夜者需要调查来到这边的人是否安全。如果你有时间的话，我希望你可以来廷根湖这边协助我们调查。
　　新同事，期待着与你再一次见面。
ref_en:
Long time no see.
　　Since the mutation of Tingen Lake, the Nighthawks have blocked the area around Tingen Lake to deal with the remaining corruption, and it has now been processed and the blockade has been lifted.
　　However, colleagues on patrol recently told me that a few tables, chairs, and tents have suddenly appeared by the lake recently. It should be that after the blockade was lifted, someone came here to carry out activities.
　　To be safe, the Nighthawks need to investigate whether the people who came here are safe. If you have time, I hope you can come to Tingen Lake to assist us in the investigation.
　　New colleague, looking forward to meeting you again.

source_cn: 这个世界实在是太无聊了！连像样的小说也没有，更别提网文、游戏和电影了，只能靠我自己来写了。\n        穿越到这个世界已经很久了，自从成为“通识者”途径的非凡者后，我靠着魔药的力量完整地回想起以前学过的所有知识，赞美义务教育与我的二本学历！然后我大抄特抄……哦，是将先进的文化与知识传播到这个世界。\n        凭借着才华与魅力，贵族们拉拢我，教会也喜欢我，没落的古斯塔夫家族又一次站在这个王国的顶端，我那便宜老爹老妈真应该谢谢我。但也有些想念我真正的家，成为这个途径的非凡者也是为了找到回家的方法。黄涛啊黄
ref_en: This world is just too boring! There are no decent novels, let alone web novels, games, or movies; I have to write them myself. \n It has been a long time since I crossed into this world. Ever since I became a Beyonder of the "Savant" pathway, I have relied on the power of the potion to fully recall all the knowledge I learned before. Praise compulsory education and my undergraduate degree! Then I copied and copied… oh, I mean, I spread advanced culture and knowledge to this world. \n Relying on talent and charm, the nobles court me, the Church likes me, and the fallen Gustav Family stands at the top of this kingdom once again. My cheap old man and old lady should really thank me. But I also miss my real home. Becoming a Beyonder of this pathway is also to find a way home. Huang Tao, ah Huang

source_cn:
戴莉艰难地笑了笑，对抗着体表不断冒出的白色绒毛和漆黑鳞片道：
　　“原来是你……
　　“你之前不是问我，为什么不主动，主动向邓恩表白，将他推到，床上？”
　　她吸了口气，苦涩笑道：
　　“我过去有过，太多的放纵，他，他是一个保守的人，我，我很自卑。”
　　她已快控制不住，即将变成怪物。
　　这个时候，她听见克莱恩·莫雷蒂回应道：
　　“队长其实很喜欢你，但你太优秀太年轻了，他也很自卑。”
　　戴莉笑了，旋即在朦胧的视线里看见了那个身穿黑色风衣，发际线较高，有幽邃灰眸的男人，看见他以手按胸，弯腰伸掌，邀请自己跳舞。
　　她探出了自己的手，她的思绪随之变得滞涩。
　　穿黑风衣的灰眸男人拉起了异变逐渐退去的戴莉，在伦纳德的目光中，在喷泉乱流的破败广场里，跳起了轻快的舞蹈。
　　一样样材料飞出，有金色的葡萄藤，有较为丑陋的橡皮面具，它们在灵性的引导下，逐渐糅合在一起，灌入了一个金属小瓶。
　　美妙的舞蹈中，戴莉轻轻前靠，倚在了邓恩的怀里。

　　——第四卷《不死者》第二百一十三章 故事的尾声
ref_en:
Daly smiled with difficulty, fighting against the white fluff and pitch-black scales constantly emerging from her skin:
 "So it was you...
 "Didn't you ask me before why I didn't take the initiative, take the initiative to confess to Dunn and push him onto the bed?"
 She took a breath and smiled bitterly:
 "I've had too much indulgence in the past. He, he is a conservative person, and I, I am very insecure."
 She could no longer control herself and was about to turn into a monster.
 At this moment, she heard Klein Moretti respond:
 "The Captain actually liked you very much, but you were too outstanding and too young, and he was also very insecure."
 Daly smiled, and then in her hazy vision, she saw the man in the black trench coat with a high hairline and deep gray eyes. She saw him place his hand on his chest, bow, and extend his palm to invite her to dance.
 She reached out her hand, and her thoughts became stagnant.
 The gray-eyed man in the black trench coat pulled up Daly, whose mutation was gradually receding. Under Leonard's gaze, in the dilapidated square with turbulent fountain water, they danced a light dance.
 Materials flew out one by one—golden grapevines, an ugly rubber mask—and under the guidance of spirituality, they gradually merged together and were poured into a small metal bottle.
 In the midst of the beautiful dance, Daly leaned forward gently and rested in Dunn's arms.

 — Volume 4: Undying, Chapter 213: The End of the Story

source_cn:
生活太<Letter_RedBig>辛苦</>了，像我们这样穷苦的人，生来似乎就是为了劳作的。
　　如果不劳作，今天吃完了饭，就要操心明天的饭在哪里。
　　如果运气好，工厂给了我劳作的机会，今天工作结束，又要操心明天的工作。
　　冷的时候，手上会长<Letter_RedBig>疮口</>，一点一点冻掉我的肉。
　　热的时候，棉絮会钻进我的肺部，让我一点一点咳出我的<Letter_RedBig>灵魂</>。
　　对我这样的人来说，明天是一种负担。
　　“永暗的蜡烛，不毁的身躯”，我想要什么也不管，什么也不顾……直接睡过去。
ref_en:
Life is too <Letter_RedBig>hard</>. For poor people like us, we seem to be born just to toil.
　　If we don't toil, once we finish today's meal, we have to worry about where tomorrow's will come from.
　　If we are lucky and the factory gives me a chance to work, once today's work is done, I have to worry about tomorrow's work.
　　When it's cold, sores grow on my hands, <Letter_RedBig>sores</> that slowly freeze away my flesh.
　　When it's hot, cotton fibers drill into my lungs, making me cough out my <Letter_RedBig>soul</> bit by bit.
　　For someone like me, tomorrow is a burden.
　　"Candle of Eternal Darkness, Indestructible Body," I want to ignore everything, not care about anything... and just fall asleep.

“它是通灵的好帮手，也是足够迷人的花精……”
　　随着戴莉的娓娓述说，克莱恩只觉她的声音从四面八方传来。
　　迷惑望向四周，克莱恩发现所有事物都在摇晃，都在模糊，像是笼罩了一层又一层的浓雾，连带着自己的身体都跟着摇晃，跟着模糊，跟着发飘，跟着失去了重量。
　　红的更红，蓝的更蓝，黑的更黑，色彩混杂如同印象派油画，迷离而梦幻，而周围细碎重叠的呢喃一阵阵传来，像是有数不清的无形之人在议论。
　　“这和我之前做‘转运仪式’时的感觉类似啊，但没有那种让人疯狂，让人想要爆炸的味道……”克莱恩看着这一切，疑惑想道。
　　就在这时，他的视线被一双晶莹如同绿宝石的眼眸吸引了，穿黑袍的戴莉坐在模糊的“沙发”上，目光诡异地集中于克莱恩的头顶，嗓音温柔地笑道：
　　“正式认识一下，我，‘通灵者’戴莉。”

　　——第一卷《小丑》 第十四章 信
ref_en:
"It's a great helper for Spirit Mediumship, and also a charming flower spirit..."
 As Daly spoke, Klein felt her voice coming from all directions.
 Looking around in confusion, Klein found that everything was swaying and blurring, as if shrouded in layers of thick fog. Even his own body was swaying, blurring, floating, and losing its weight.
 The reds became redder, the blues bluer, and the blacks blacker, the colors mixing like an impressionist oil painting, hazy and dreamlike. The fragmented, overlapping whispers around him came in waves, as if countless invisible people were discussing.
 "This is similar to the feeling I had when I did the 'Fortune-Turning Ritual', but without that flavor that makes people go crazy or want to explode..." Klein thought, looking at all this in confusion.
 Just then, his gaze was drawn to a pair of eyes as crystalline as emeralds. Daly, dressed in a black robe, sat on a blurry "sofa," her gaze strangely focused on the top of Klein's head, her voice smiling gently:
 "Let's get to know each other formally. I am the 'Spirit Medium', Daly."

 — Volume 1: Clown, Chapter 14: Letter

不同的人脉之间也有着特殊的<Highlight>关系</>，集齐对应人脉即可解锁/提升相应的关系，精进自己对历史的研究。
根据历史研究程度，可获得一定的属性加成。
关系可分为<Highlight>协战关系</>和<Highlight>历史关系</>两类，两者都可以提升历史研究。
对于协战关系，解锁后还能为部分人脉提供一定的能力增强，但是对于一个人脉只能生效一种协战关系的提升效果。

ref_en:
There are also special <Highlight>relationships</> between different contacts. Collecting corresponding contacts will unlock/upgrade the corresponding relationship, refining your research on history. 
Depending on the level of historical research, you can obtain certain attribute bonuses. 
Relationships can be divided into two categories: <Highlight>Co-combat Relationship</> and <Highlight>Historical Relationship</>, both of which can improve historical research. 
For Co-combat Relationships, unlocking them can also provide certain ability enhancements for some contacts, but only one Co-combat Relationship enhancement effect can be active for a single contact. 

In the Strategy Server, when a Co-combat Relationship reaches the [True Form] level, it can connect to the power of the tributary of fate. Use <Highlight>Tributary Crystals</> to <Highlight>Awaken</> it to increase the tributary scale, thereby obtaining Echoes of Fate and increasing the Echo Scale to gain additional attribute boosts in the Strategy Server. (This attribute only takes effect in the Strategy Server.)

source_cn:
吟游诗人携着鲁特琴，在广袤的大陆上收集故事，所有的故事终将伴着琴声，成为风格迥异的歌。
据说，当吟游诗人的琴歌足够动人，能在一个地区的街巷与炉火间口耳相传，甚至点亮了听者的一丝明悟，那条旋律便会在琴弦的拨动中，汇集百感，凝结成音石。 
佩戴音石时，故去的旋律将在耳边重新鸣响，故事中的情感也会充斥内心，层叠如潮涌。不同故事孕育的音石，其质感与情感也截然不同：
当故事发生在辉煌的因蒂斯宫廷，凝结的音石往往光华流转，回荡着精致、浪漫而略带哀愁的贵族情思。当故事发生在信仰知识与智慧之神的地域，回响的情绪也更为平静、节制，仿佛一段被严密论证的哲思。
吟游诗人乐于分享它们，就如乐于分享琴曲与歌声。
ref_en:
Bards carry lutes, collecting stories across the vast continent. All stories will eventually accompany the sound of the strings, becoming songs of vastly different styles. 
It is said that when a bard's lute song is moving enough to be passed down by word of mouth through the streets and hearths of a region, and even ignites a glimmer of enlightenment in the listener, that melody will gather a hundred feelings in the plucking of the strings, condensing into a Sound Stone. 
When wearing a Sound Stone, the melodies of the past will ring in your ears again, and the emotions within the stories will fill your heart, surging like a tide. Sound Stones born from different stories have vastly different textures and emotions: 
When a story takes place in the glorious Intis court, the condensed Sound Stone often shimmers with light, echoing with the exquisite, romantic, and slightly melancholic sentiments of the nobility. When a story takes place in a region that believes in the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, the echoing emotions are calmer and more restrained, as if they were a rigorously argued philosophical thought. 
Bards are happy to share them, just as they are happy to share their lute music and songs.

source_cn:
戈登和戴维发现了山顶一个被积雪覆盖的遗迹入口，他们回到营地，将消息报告给曼斯教授，教授当即带着一些学者和几个护卫往山上赶。
　　而我和另外几个学员则留在了营地，准备必要的物资。边搬东西的时候我边想，不久后我也要称呼他们为"研究员先生"了吧。
　　新遗迹的考古研究相当累人，研究员们还在遗迹入口考察建筑风格，而我们这些不受重视的学员就只能干剩下的粗重杂活……
　　傍晚回到营地后，曼斯教授很兴奋，有几个研究员提议在营地开个庆功宴，曼斯教授也同意了，大家终于能放松一下了。
ref_en:
Gordon and David discovered a ruins entrance covered by snow at the summit. They returned to the camp and reported the news to Professor Mans. The professor immediately took some scholars and a few guards and rushed up the mountain.
　　As for me and a few other students, we stayed at the camp to prepare the necessary supplies. While moving things, I thought to myself that before long, I would also be calling them "Mr. Researcher."
　　The archaeological research of the new ruins is quite exhausting. The researchers are still examining the architectural style at the ruins entrance, while we, the undervalued students, can only do the remaining heavy, menial work...
　　After returning to the camp in the evening, Professor Mans was very excited. Several researchers proposed holding a celebration party at the camp, and Professor Mans agreed. Everyone could finally relax a bit.
